description: This file defines the EmployeeSupervisorAPI class, which provides RESTful endpoints for managing an employee's supervisor relationships within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting supervisor data, along with validation rules and annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: EmployeeSupervisorAPI
classes.description: API class for managing employee supervisor relationships including retrieval, creation, update, and deletion functionalities with integrated validation and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific supervisor entry for an employee based on employee number and supervisor ID, returning a modeled representation of the supervisor.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all supervisors associated with a specific employee, support sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new supervisor relationship for an employee based on provided request body parameters.

methods.name: setSupervisorParams
methods.description: Sets the properties of a ReportTo entity from request parameters for supervisor creation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the reporting method details for an existing supervisor relationship.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts employee number and supervisor ID from URL attributes for processing.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne endpoint, primarily for employee number and ID access control.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for listing supervisors, including sort and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Specifies validation rules required for creating a new supervisor relationship.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for updating a supervisor's reporting method.

methods.name: getEmpNumberRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for employee number parameter.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for reporting method ID parameter.

methods.name: getSupervisorIdsRule
methods.description: Validation rule for array of supervisor IDs when deleting.
